title: SBRUG: Sampling Best Response in Undercutting Games
description:
SBRUG (Sampling Best Response in Undercutting Games) is a NetLogo model that compares two ways of revising a strategy in undercutting games, such as the traveler's dilemma and the finitely repeated prisoner's dilemma: best responding to the strategies of a few randomly observed agents (Sampling BR), and best responding to the exact population state (Exact BR). Both rules run side by side, on two populations that share the revising agents and the experiments.

The model runs in the browser at https://luis-r-izquierdo.github.io/sbrug/, and in NetLogo 7.0.4 or later.

Related paper: Luis R. Izquierdo and Segismundo S. Izquierdo, "How Sampling and Experimentation Sustain Cooperation in Undercutting Games".
